status: UNAPPLIED optional classic-stream state-machine candidate. Host algorithms only; no selected native engine/component evidence.
moduleContract: Finite root and promises namespaces. Root default is callable Stream; Stream.Stream is itself; shared constructors retain installed EventEmitter ancestry. Root.promises equals promises.default; pipeline/finished custom-promisify getters return matching promise bindings. Named ESM bindings snapshot installation values. Mutable default graphs do not synchronize named exports. Literal static CommonJS lowering returns default. No runtime public require/process or globals.

node:stream.callablePolicy: Candidate implementation of ordinary core constructors/lifecycle in the stated domain; deferred callable members throw own-coded ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call/new including top-level code.
node:stream.unsupportedPrototypePolicy: Readable compose/map/filter/forEach/toArray/some/find/every/flatMap/drop/take/reduce/iterator and Readable/Writable Symbol.asyncDispose are explicit throwing functions. asIndexedPairs is absent because not in Node22. Inherited copies of these deferred methods on Duplex remain deferred.
deviations: No native component gate yet; host reference scheduling is not the guest scheduler.

Byte inputs are ordinary attached fixed unshared ArrayBufferViews; raw byte windows preserve offset/backing, not element truncation. Shared/resizable/detached/proxy/exotic state domains are not claimed.
Default byte HWM is deterministically65536 and object HWM16. HWM remains a threshold, not a memory bound.

Queue budget units match Node state.length: bytes before decoding or UTF16 code units after decoding. Object/chunk counts do not bound arbitrary application payload or total memory. Discard a stream after its profile limit failure; full atomic rollback is not claimed.
Only existing bounded Buffer/StringDecoder encodings and errors apply; no Buffer pool, copy/concat/write/numeric API expansion.
Web overloads, function pipeline stages, pair/compose/operators/disposal/legacy module aliases remain deferred. This candidate does not register consumers or stream/web.

Registration getter/return-then-getter/Symbol.dispose identity and scheduler/reset/ALS/request teardown limitations remain independent. captureRejections:true remains explicitly unavailable through the installed Events foundation.
Public own-state mutation, arbitrary primordial mutation, full exact own-property reflection/error text/stack/cross-realm and async_hooks parity are not claimed.

node:stream/promises.callablePolicy: Promise wrappers over the same bounded classic lifecycle. Native Web/function stages are explicitly deferred; no timers or host I/O.
deviations: No complete Node stream implementation or external I/O claimed.
